mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that boosts equity markets, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during easing periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in unemployment rate above 8% triggers a negative signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as high unemployment indicates a slowing economy.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts and GDP growth are both increasing, it signals a strong demand environment that will drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window for this interaction-driven signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production signals reduced supply chain activity, which will lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate above 4% will lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as higher rates increase borrowing costs.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during tightening periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment and unemployment rate are both improving, it signals a strong labor market that will drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window for this interaction-driven signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail sales signals reduced consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a decrease in the federal funds rate below 2% will lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as lower rates stimulate economic growth.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during recovery periods (t-test p > 0.05).
